newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's TRI chairman raises stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's TRI chairman raises stake.

text.p: Tajudin Ramli, chairman of Technology Resources Industries Bhd (TRI), has increased his holding in the company through the indirect purchase of 67.79 million shares and the direct acquisition of 10,000 shares.

In a disclosure released by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Wednesday, Tajudin said the October 8 indirect purchase was made through a private placement. The acquisition brings his indirect stock holdings in diversified TRI to 173.42 million shares.

Tajudin also said he had purchased 10,000 TRI shares directly through the exercise of an executive share option scheme on October 10, bringing his direct holdings in the company to 15.24 million shares.
TRI has over 680 million shares. It recently entered into a strategic alliance with Deutsche Telekom under which the German company acquired about 20 percent of its stock.
